title: First-Layer Failure Hotspot by Model
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), Klipper resonance metrics (`klipper:telemetry`), resin print logs (`resinprint:job`), tool usage (`tool:usage`), filament inventory (`filament:spool`), and workshop air readings (`workshop:air`).
app: Maker telemetry from OctoPrint, Moonraker, printer firmware sensors, resin printer job logs, smart dryboxes, and workshop tool sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=octoprint:job result="failed" stage="first_layer"
| stats count as first_layer_failures by model printer
| sort - first_layer_failures
description: Counts first-layer failures by model and printer so problematic combinations surface immediately.
value: First-layer issues waste time and filament fast, and grouping them by model shows whether the problem is bed setup, slicing, or one machine.
implementation: Tag job outcomes with the stage of failure from OctoPrint or Moonraker and review recurring offenders weekly.
visualization: Bar chart of first-layer failures by model and printer.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which print designs keep failing right at the start, so you can fix the setup that causes the waste.
